description: Na₃GeSe₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. There are three inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.89-3.46 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.97-3.24 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.98-3.33 Å. Ge is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to three Se atoms. There are two shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.36 Å) Ge-Se bond length. There are three inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na and one Ge atom. In the second Se site, Se is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to six Na and one Ge atom. In the third Se site, Se is bonded to six Na and one Ge atom to form distorted face-sharing SeNa₆Ge pentagonal bipyramids.
